messages:
Rina (FinOps): Nemora Labs flagged invoice INV-2026-076 showing both reserved usage line and a separate overage for the same time window (2026-03-05 03:00-04:30 UTC). Looks like a duplicate charge. Anyone able to confirm?
Luis (Acct Mgr): I saw their ticket. They attached a screenshot: reserved_hours=120, billed_shared_hours=18, total_billed_hours=138. They say the 18 should've been covered by failover policy.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-076 posted. reserved_commit_hours=120, billed_reserved_hours=120, billed_shared_hours=18, shared_charge=$3,564.
Marta (Customer Success): Nemora claims they were in a scheduled cross-region failover (primary us-central -> backup europe-north) and expected the vendor to route to their reserved fallback pool. They say they didn't spin additional capacity.
Theo (SRE): Pulled autoscaler and failover logs: `grep -A3 "failover" /var/logs/orch/2026-03-05.log` shows failover triggered at 03:12, pods recreated with nodeSelector `region=europe-north` but label `pool=missing-dedicated` present on only two nodes. The fallback pool name used by infra is `nemora-dedicated-eu` but provider meter shows events for `nemora-shared-eu` as well.
Theo (SRE): My hypothesis: orchestration created pods in fallback region, vendor's routing set matched names loosely and duplicated meter events to both dedicated and shared meters for the same pod lifecycle.
Rina (FinOps): If vendor duplicated meters that's vendor error and we'd reverse. If the workload actually consumed non-reserved shared capacity, customer owes it. We need vendor audit of raw meter events keyed by pod id.
Luis (Acct Mgr): Reaching out to vendor now for pod-id-level mapping (requesting CSV of meter events with pod_id, node_id, meter_type). Also proposing we offer Nemora a temporary goodwill credit to reduce churn risk.
billing-bot: Created vendor request VND-4608: request detailed meter dump for INV-2026-076. Created internal ticket FIN-3419 for potential credit processing.
Nora (Legal): Small reminder: any credit tied to contractual changes needs counter-signed addendum; administrative refunds under $5k can be approved by FinOps with a note.
Marta (Customer Success): Nemora is nervous; they run a GenAI eval at night and can't afford surprise bills. They're asking for immediate provisional credit while vendor audits.
Rina (FinOps): Provisional credit: we can put a $2,500 hold/adjustment against their account pending vendor confirmation. If vendor confirms duplication error, we'll reverse shared_charge fully and refund. If not, we apply up to $2,500 goodwill and bill remainder. Approve?
Theo (SRE): I'll share the pod lifecycle IDs and timestamps with the vendor; also I'll add an assertion to our deploy pipeline that ensures fallback pool exists in each failover region (quick patch).
Luis (Acct Mgr): Nemora agreed to the provisional credit and will sign a short ops acknowledgement to run a failover test with SRE in the next 72 hours. I'll draft the acknowledgement and attach to FIN-3419.
billing-bot: FIN-3419 updated: provisional_credit=$2,500, status=pending_customer_ack. VND-4608 assigned to vendor-billing-team.
Nora (Legal): If we do a provisional adjustment, note it on the invoice as 'pending_adjustment: INV-2026-076 - provisional credit $2,500'. Legal ok with acknowledgement wording.
Rina (FinOps): Approved provisional hold up to $2.5k. Condition: vendor audit within 7 business days and customer completes failover test within 72 hours. If vendor finds duplication, full reversal. If vendor finds valid shared usage, apply goodwill up to $2.5k and notify customer of remaining balance.
Luis (Acct Mgr): I'll push vendor for the pod-level CSV today and email Nemora with the acknowledgment form.
Marta (Customer Success): I'll schedule the SRE <-> Nemora ops call for tomorrow morning PT.
Theo (SRE): Patch created: `ci/validate-failover-pool.sh` adds check for `nemora-dedicated-*` present in target region; PR coming.
billing-bot: VND-4608 vendor response expected by 2026-03-12. FIN-3419 updated: next_action=awaiting_vendor_csv.
Rina (FinOps): Closing note: track outcomes in FIN-3419; Luis to update thread with vendor CSV or vendor denial. If vendor confirms duplication, finance will issue reversal and notify Nemora.
Luis (Acct Mgr): Will update. Thanks all.
